$comment: EDE-46 (eDE IDE-look shell, 2026-11-06): THE SHELL REDUCER the IDE and eDE both host (ide = shell + uicore, ede = compositor + uicore): reduce(state, event) -> state, pure, no clock, no I/O, plus the selectors the documents read; the uicore-model crate replays every case in Rust. STATE (every key always present): rail (the 272 px sidebar collapsed to the 56 px icon rail); sidebar {pinnedOpen, workspacesOpen, sessionsOpen} (folded sections); switcher {current {kind local|team, id, name}, entries [...]} (the desktop/team switcher top-left; `initial` has one local desktop `Local`); windows [{id, app, title, focused, workspace, minimized}] in the order the reducer learned them (window.opened appends, no event restacks, so the taskbar never jumps); mru [id] most recent first; workspaces {active (0-based, as ede-protocol), count}; taskbar {pinned [app], hover app|null, previews app|null, menu app|null}; startMenu {open, query, category (`all` by default)}; chat {open}; altTab {open, selected: an index into altTabOrder(state), which is the mru on one workspace}. CASES: `reduce` = {name, state, event, expected}: `state` lists complete top-level keys over `initial` (a key left out = initial's), `expected` lists the top-level keys that changed, complete; every key left out must be unchanged. Each selector = {name, state, args?, expected} with the full return value; startMenuApps/startMenuCategories take `apps` and `favourites` from the fixture's top level unless `args` gives them. EVENTS: rail.toggle flips rail. sidebar.toggle {section pinned|workspaces|sessions} flips that section (unknown: nothing). switcher.pick {entryKind, id} makes a listed entry current (unlisted: nothing; kind and id both match). switcher.set {entries} replaces the list, keeps current when its kind+id is still listed (taking the listed name), else the first entry; an empty list changes nothing (there is always a local desktop). window.opened {id, app, title, workspace} appends {focused false, minimized false} and puts the id at the END of the mru (a known id: nothing); the compositor's window.focused follows. window.closed {id} removes it from windows and mru, closes taskbar.previews when its app has no window left, and keeps altTab.selected in range (no window left: Alt-Tab closes). window.focused {id} focuses it, blurs every other, restores it when minimized, moves it to the front of the mru (unknown: nothing). window.titled {id, title}. window.minimized {id}: minimized true, focused false, mru unchanged. window.restored {id}: minimized false, focus unchanged. window.moved {id, workspace}: changes its workspace when 0 <= workspace < count, then keeps altTab.selected in range. workspace.switched {active}: 0 <= active < count, else nothing; keeps altTab.selected in range. workspace.count {count}: max(1, count); an active index or a window beyond it moves to the last workspace (Mint's rule). taskbar.pin {app} appends once; taskbar.unpin removes; taskbar.hover {app} / taskbar.unhover set hover. taskbar.previews {app|null} and taskbar.menu {app|null}: ONE POPUP AT A TIME: a non-null app closes the other taskbar popup and the start menu (open false, query and category cleared); null closes just that popup. startMenu.open sets open and closes the taskbar previews and menu, keeping an existing query and category; startMenu.close sets open false, query ``, category `all`; startMenu.toggle is one or the other; startMenu.query {query} stores the text as typed (the selector lowercases and trims); startMenu.category {category}. chat.toggle flips chat.open; the chat is independent of every popup. altTab.next / altTab.prev: order = altTabOrder(state); no window: nothing; closed: open with selected = 1 for next and n-1 for prev when n >= 2, else 0; open: step by one, wrapping. altTab.commit: the window at order[selected] gets the window.focused treatment, then altTab = {open false, selected 0}; closed: nothing. altTab.cancel: {open false, selected 0}, focus unchanged. SELECTORS: taskbarButtons(state) -> [{app, pinned, windows [id], focused, minimized, running}]: Mint's grouped window list, pinned apps first in pin order (a pinned app without a window on the active workspace is still a button, running false, windows []), then the running unpinned apps in the order of their first window in `windows`; only the ACTIVE workspace's windows count, a group's `windows` keep the compositor order, focused = any window focused, minimized = every window minimized (and at least one), running = at least one window. taskbarPress(state, app) -> {action}: Mint's click: no window on the active workspace -> {action launch}; one: focused and not minimized -> {action minimize, id}, else {action focus, id}; several -> {action previews}. taskbarScroll(state, app, direction up|down) -> {action focus, id} | null: cycles the group's windows (active workspace, compositor order) from the focused one, down = next, up = previous, wrapping; none focused: down = the first, up = the last; a single window = itself; no window = null. workspaceBadges(state) -> [{index, active, count}] for every workspace, count = its windows, minimized included. altTabOrder(state) -> [id]: the mru filtered to windows that exist, the active workspace's first, then the others, each part in mru order, minimized included. startMenuApps(state, apps, favourites) -> [{id, name, comment, category}]: apps = [{id, name, comment, categories [freedesktop], keywords}]. Groups (Mint's main groups, ids in this order): all, favourites, exponential (ids starting `at.exponential.`), accessories (Utility), administration (System, Settings), education (Education), games (Game), graphics (Graphics), internet (Network), office (Office), programming (Development), science (Science), sound-video (AudioVideo, Audio, Video), other (none of the above); an app belongs to every group its categories name and `category` in the output is its first group in that order. query = state.startMenu.query trimmed and lowercased; with >= 1 char the category is ignored and the result is ranked: 0 = the name (lowercased) starts with the query, 1 = every query word starts a word of the name, 2 = every word is found in the name, comment or keywords (lowercased), no match = out; ties by lowercase name then id. Without a query: `all` = every app by name, `favourites` = the favourite ids in their order (missing ones skipped), a group = its members by name, anything else = []. startMenuCategories(apps, favourites) -> [{id, label, count}] in Mint's order (All applications, Favourites, Exponential, Accessories, Administration, Education, Games, Graphics, Internet, Office, Programming, Science, Sound & Video, Other), only the non-empty groups plus All and Favourites always; favourites counts the installed ones. EDE-56 (Local desktops + accounts): a switcher entry may carry `account` (the Exponential account's id) and `accountName` (its email) for a team of a connected account; a local desktop has neither. switcherSections(state) -> [{kind local|account, id, label, entries [{kind, id, name, account?, accountName?, current}]}]: the Local desktops section first (`id` local, label `Local desktops`, every local entry in listed order), then one section per account in the order its first entry appears (`id` = the account, label = its accountName, else the account), each entry marked `current` when it is the switcher's current one (kind and id); a team entry without an account joins a section `id` `` labelled `Exponential`.

reduce.name: rail.toggle collapses the sidebar to the icon rail
rail.toggle again brings the full sidebar back
sidebar.toggle folds the pinned section

sidebar.toggle with an unknown section changes nothing
switcher.pick moves to a listed team
switcher.pick of an unlisted entry changes nothing
switcher.pick matches the kind as well as the id
switcher.set keeps the current entry when it is still listed and takes its new name
switcher.set falls back to the first entry when the current one is gone
switcher.set with an empty list changes nothing (there is always a local desktop)
window.opened appends the window unfocused on its workspace and at the end of the mru
window.opened on another workspace keeps that workspace
window.opened with a known id changes nothing
window.focused focuses one window, blurs the others and moves it to the front of the mru
window.focused restores a minimized window
window.focused with an unknown id changes nothing
window.closed removes the window from the list and the mru
window.closed with an unknown id changes nothing
window.closed of the last window of an app closes its previews
window.closed keeps the previews open while the app still has a window
window.closed while Alt-Tab is open keeps the selection in range
window.closed of the only window while Alt-Tab is open closes Alt-Tab
window.titled renames a window
window.minimized minimizes and blurs the window and keeps it in the mru
window.restored brings a minimized window back without focusing it
window.moved puts a window on another workspace
window.moved to a workspace that does not exist changes nothing
workspace.switched changes the active workspace
workspace.switched out of range changes nothing
workspace.count grows the workspaces
workspace.count shrinking below the active one moves the active workspace and its windows to the last one
workspace.count below one is one
taskbar.pin appends an app to the pinned list
taskbar.pin of a pinned app changes nothing
taskbar.unpin removes an app from the pinned list
taskbar.hover marks the hovered button
taskbar.unhover clears the hovered button
taskbar.previews opens the hover previews of a group and closes the button menu and the start menu
taskbar.previews null closes the previews and nothing else
taskbar.menu opens the button menu and closes the previews and the start menu
taskbar.menu null closes the button menu
startMenu.toggle opens the start menu
startMenu.toggle closes it and clears the query and the category
startMenu.open closes the taskbar previews (one popup at a time)
startMenu.open closes the taskbar button menu (one popup at a time)
startMenu.open leaves an open chat alone (they are independent)
startMenu.open while open keeps the query and the category
startMenu.close clears the query and the category
startMenu.query sets the query as typed
startMenu.category picks a category
chat.toggle opens the chat
chat.toggle closes the chat
chat.toggle leaves an open start menu open
altTab.next opens the switcher on the second most recent window
altTab.next with one window opens the switcher on it
altTab.next with no window changes nothing
altTab.next steps forward and wraps to the first
altTab.prev opens the switcher on the least recent window
altTab.prev steps back and wraps to the last
altTab.commit focuses the selected window, restores it and closes the switcher
altTab.commit while the switcher is closed changes nothing
altTab.cancel closes the switcher without changing focus
altTab.next counts the active workspace's windows before the other workspaces' ones
altTab.commit on the second entry focuses the active workspace's next window, not the mru's
workspace.switched while Alt-Tab is open keeps the selection in range of the new order

taskbarButtons.name: taskbarButtons lists the pinned apps first in pin order, then the running ones in the order their first window appeared
taskbarButtons keeps a pinned app with no window as a button that is not running
taskbarButtons shows the active workspace's windows only
taskbarButtons marks a group minimized only when every window of it is
taskbarButtons keeps a group's windows in the compositor's order
taskbarButtons on an empty desktop is empty

taskbarPress.name: taskbarPress on a button without a window launches the app
taskbarPress on the focused single window minimizes it
taskbarPress on an unfocused single window focuses it

taskbarPress ignores windows on other workspaces

taskbarScroll.name: taskbarScroll down focuses the group's next window after the focused one
taskbarScroll down wraps from the group's last window to its first
taskbarScroll up wraps from the group's first window to its last

taskbarScroll with no focused window in the group goes down to its first
taskbarScroll with no focused window in the group goes up to its last
taskbarScroll on a single window focuses it
taskbarScroll on a button without a window does nothing
